comment: Independent getpos.c unexplored-cycle recipe: a dwarvish Valkyrie (infravision, Stealth) walks to the square inside the south doorway, searches 11 turns (these only advance the random-number stream so that the next creation lands outside the doorway), puts on a wished-for blindfold, steps blind into the doorway, creates a sleeping floating eye, which lands on the never-seen corridor square beyond it, steps back and removes the blindfold. The eye is then seen by infravision on a square whose remembered glyph is still unexplored. gather_locs_interesting() GLOC_EXPLORE tests IS_UNEXPLORED_LOC() against levl[x][y].glyph, not the displayed monster glyph, so x selects the doorway first; the second x and the X cover forward and reverse cycling.
